entity_ranked_evidence.title: Gas pricing to find place in Aam Aadmi Party's manifesto - The Economic Times
entity_ranked_evidence.snippet: # Gas pricing to find place in Aam Aadmi Party's manifesto. The Reliance gas pricing issue is likely to find a place in AAP manifesto as the party has already indicated that it will be among the major issues. NEW DELHI: The Reliance gas pricing issue is likely to find a place in Aam Aadmi Party's (AAP) manifesto as the new party has already indicated that it will be among the major issues to target BJP and Congress in the Lok Sabha election. Also, with BJP and AAP both trying to occupy the political space created by a weakened Congress, the party will launch more fervent attacks on Narendra Modi in coming days. The party will make this a major poll issue with which it can target both the parties over the corruption issue. The party will also add this in its poll manifesto," said a party leader. "We will make it more difficult for both the BJP and Congress over the issue," another party leader added.
